summary: Halyard template mutual NDA with counterparty edits limited to entity details, spelling, notice mechanics and a contractors addition, plus comments requesting 2-year survival and Delaware/New York law.

findings.quote: [[INS: VERIDIAN CLOUD, INC.]], a company incorporated and registered in [[INS: the State of Delaware, United States of America]]
findings.why: The counterparty has inserted its own entity name, Delaware incorporation and San Francisco address and deleted the company number; no playbook rule covers this, so the lawyer must confirm the entity against the register.

findings.quote: which is either marked or identified as confidential at the time of disclosure or would reasonably be considered confidential given the nature of the information and the circumstances of its disclosure
findings.why: The definition covers information disclosed for the Purpose that is marked or reasonably confidential, includes derived notes and analyses, and protects either Disclosing Party.

findings.quote: employees, officers, directors, [[INS: independent contractors,]] professional [[DEL: advisers]] [[INS: advisors]], auditors and insurers
findings.why: The insertion extends Representatives to independent contractors, which the playbook list of permitted recipients does not include and no ACCEPTABLE line covers, so it is judged a deviation with low confidence.
findings.draft_redline: Representatives means, in relation to a Party, the employees, officers, directors, professional advisers, auditors and insurers of that Party and of any member of its Group.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We would prefer to keep the Representatives definition to employees, officers, directors, professional advisers, auditors and insurers. If a contractor needs access, please let us know and we can consider it case by case under a written confidentiality undertaking.

findings.quote: not use or exploit the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information in any way except solely for the Purpose;
findings.why: Use is limited solely to the Purpose, which is discussions regarding a potential commercial relationship.

findings.quote: not reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble or otherwise attempt to derive the composition, source code or underlying structure of any software, prototypes or other tangible objects
findings.why: Reverse engineering of software and prototypes is prohibited, as preferred.

findings.quote: can demonstrate by written records or other reasonable evidence:
findings.why: All four carve-outs (public domain, already held, third party, independent development) appear in 3.1.1 to 3.1.4 unnarrowed, with the written records or reasonable evidence standard.

findings.quote: those of its Representatives and members of its Group who strictly need to know such Confidential Information in order to evaluate or further the Purpose
findings.why: Disclosure is permitted to Representatives and Group members on a need-to-know basis and the Receiving Party remains liable for them under 4.1.3.

findings.quote: The Receiving Party may disclose the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information to the minimum extent required by an order of any court of competent jurisdiction
findings.why: Compelled disclosure is permitted, notice is only to the extent legally permitted (5.2), and resisting disclosure is at the Disclosing Party's cost (5.2.3).

findings.quote: within ten Business Days of receipt of such request:
findings.why: Ten Business Days, officer-signed confirmation and a backup and legally required copies exception (6.2) that stays confidential (6.3) match the preferred position.

findings.quote: All Confidential Information, and all intellectual property rights in or relating to it, shall remain the exclusive property of the Disclosing Party (or its licensors, as applicable).
findings.why: Ownership stays with the Disclosing Party and 7.2 grants no licence beyond use for the Purpose.

findings.quote: save that nothing in this Agreement shall exclude or limit either Party's liability for fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation.
findings.why: Information is provided as is with mutual disclaimers, the fraud carve-out is kept, and 7.5 states there is no obligation to proceed.

findings.quote: Neither Party shall make, or permit any person to make, any public announcement, press release or other public disclosure
findings.why: Mutual publicity restriction requiring prior written consent, except as required by law.

findings.quote: The Parties do not anticipate that the disclosure of Confidential Information for the Purpose will involve the sharing or processing of any personal data
findings.why: No personal data beyond business contact details is expected and 9.2 requires a separate DPA or data sharing agreement before any other personal data is shared.

findings.quote: shall survive the expiry or termination of this Agreement for a period of three (3) years from the effective date of expiry or termination
findings.why: Three-year survival with Trade Secrets protected while they remain Trade Secrets matches the preferred position; the counterparty comment asks for 2 years, which RQ01 and the 2 to 5 year ACCEPTABLE line would permit if Trade Secret protection is kept.

findings.quote: for a period of two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party giving not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the other Party.
findings.why: Two-year term with 30 days' notice to terminate early is the preferred position.

findings.quote: a Party shall be entitled to seek the remedies of injunction, specific performance and other equitable relief for any threatened or actual breach of this Agreement by the other Party
findings.why: Mutual right to seek equitable relief with cumulative remedies in 11.2.

findings.quote: Neither Party may assign, novate, transfer, mortgage, charge, subcontract, declare a trust over or deal in any other manner with any or all of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party.
findings.why: No assignment by either Party without prior written consent.

findings.quote: Execution by a Party by means of an electronic signature platform [[INS: (such as DocuSign or Adobe Sign)]] shall be as valid and effectual as if executed by handwritten signature.
findings.why: Counterparts and electronic signature are already permitted; the insertion only gives examples.

findings.quote: shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the law of England and Wales.
findings.why: The clause remains England and Wales law (the comment asking for Delaware or New York law is not an edit to the text), and 12.11 gives exclusive England and Wales jurisdiction; the request to change law must be declined or escalated under RQ03.
